title: Shoggoth wall art — round 09: no crown, distinct tentacles, vicious mouth
notes: Vote S6/S5/S1/S2. Which body carries forward, and which tentacle flow? Got sketches? Send any time; we won't wait. ··· Built from your round-08 notes: no crown; three distinct tentacles of clearly different weight (massive / medium / thin whip), each one sweep to its shelf; uncrowded; octopus-like with suckers; a vicious mouth (52 blade teeth, 40-46 mm fangs); mismatched unhealthy eyes. S5/S6 are your round-08 A edited; S1/S2 are new flow layouts from the brainstorm. Our honest read: the mouth now reads vicious and S6's big slit eye lands, but the bodies are smooth between ribs, which keeps a cartoon edge; A's lace texture is reduced. S1/S2 flow best to the shelves; S5/S6 keep the most of A. Canva concept art: approved by you, but the account has no AI credits — add credits at canva.com and we'll generate up to 10 concepts. Not yet peer-signed: the CAD write-up for these studies (composition_r09).

cards.title: S6 — A without crown, distinct tentacles, fangs, big eyes
cards.rationale: Your round-08 A, edited: crown gone; three weight-ladder tentacles grip the shelves; root cascade thinned; long inward fangs; a 66 mm hooded slit-pupil eye beside the mask, a clouded eye low-left, small eyes clustered and one on the massive tentacle.

cards.title: S5 — same as S6, quieter eyes
cards.rationale: S6's body and mouth with smaller, subtler eyes — the eye-intensity question.

cards.title: S1 — fan: body left, limbs fan across bare wall
cards.rationale: Brainstorm idea 'weight ladder + asymmetric fan': the body sits left, the massive limb runs low, the medium mid, the whip rises to a top shelf; lots of bare wall for the eye to rest.

cards.title: S2 — reach: body low, limbs climb a diagonal
cards.rationale: Brainstorm idea 'reach': the body sits low-left and the three limbs climb up and to the right, one shelf per step.

cards.title: A — round-08, for comparison
cards.rationale: The round-08 study you called an extreme improvement (crown rejected). Compare what S5/S6 kept and lost.
